in_marathi.name: Sharwanand
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Quencher's Desire
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharwanand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharwanand is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'sharas' (quencher of desire) and 'anand' (bliss). It refers to the Hindu deity Shiva, who is believed to grant the desires of his devotees, hence the name 'Lord of the Quencher's Desire'.
